title: Mercury header
description: Transparent, edge-to-edge top bar: a fine-line emblem with a letter-spaced wordmark on the left, a centred nav with small chevrons, a quiet sign-in link and a periwinkle pill on the right. Phones get a three-line button that opens a rounded card menu.
notes: overlay (on by default) lets it lie on top of the hero art; turn it off on plain pages
the phone menu is a native <details> disclosure, so it works without JavaScript
name: mercury-header

props.name: login
props.description: the quiet text link on the right, e.g. "Log in"

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for the phone menu button

props.name: overlay
props.description: lie on top of the next section (a hero with art behind) instead of pushing it down
